templateOptions.label: BaseUrl
templateOptions.description: Smile URL without path, e.g. https://example.kader-platform.nl

templateOptions.label: EnvGUID
templateOptions.description: The part of the webhook URL between /api/webhook/ and /employee/

templateOptions.label: WebhookGUID
templateOptions.description: The API key of the Employee (Medewerker) webhook in Smile

templateOptions.label: DepartmentWebhookGUID
templateOptions.description: Optional, only for resource creation. The API key of the Department (Afdeling) webhook. Enter the WebhookGUID value when one webhook is used

templateOptions.label: TitleWebhookGUID
templateOptions.description: Optional, only for resource creation. The API key of the Title (Functie) webhook. Enter the WebhookGUID value when one webhook is used

templateOptions.label: TenantGUID
templateOptions.description: Optional, the last part of the employee webhook URL, after the WebhookGUID
